text:
sara_cs: Heads-up — Nimbus (enterprise acct NIM-03) reporting that the $10k promo credit from Sales did not attach to invoice inv_2024_1108_0923. They have a PO note saying 'Apply Q4 promo'. Customer is unhappy, asked for an immediate manual grant.

sara_cs: Quick repro I ran in staging: billing ingestion -> credit evaluator -> decision=SKIP. Looks like PO note got flagged as an override to skip auto-credits. Logs below.

sara_cs: ```
billing-run: credit-orch v2.1
invoice_id=inv_2024_1108_0923
customer=NIM-03
promo_code=SALES-ENTERPRISE-10K
po_note="Apply Q4 promo"
decision=SKIP
reason=po_note_override_v2:matched_pattern 'manual'
```

sara_cs: curl to eval endpoint: `curl -s -X GET "https://internal/api/v1/credit_eval?invoice=inv_2024_1108_0923"` returned `{"status":"skip","trigger":"po_note_override_v2"}` — so the evaluator is returning skip.

tom_sales: @sara_cs who on Sales created the PO? I wrote the promo language but explicitly wrote 'Apply Q4 promo' not 'manual'. Did the rep append anything else?

sara_cs: @tom_sales customer uploaded the PO PDF, I copied the note verbatim. No 'manual' word in the note.

jess_eng: I'll take this. On first glance po_note_override_v2 has an overly aggressive matcher that looks for substrings like 'apply' near other keywords and can misclassify.

jess_eng: quick diagnostic: ran the PO note text through the matcher locally: input="Apply Q4 promo" -> matcher labels="manual_override" (false positive). Repro steps for eng: `python tools/po_note_matcher/test_case.py --text "Apply Q4 promo"`

mike_revops: Hold on any DB updates — we need an approver and an audit trail. If we do a manual credit we must record ledger entry and approver name.

alan_support: I can do manual grant through the ops console if we have approval in thread. Need amount and who approves.

tom_sales: Approve manual grant for full $10,000. I approve — tom_sales (sales). Please include ledger memo referencing PO #98765 and Nimbus contact.

promo_bot: Manual credit request ticket created: TICKET-4593. Assigned to alan_support. Estimated ETA 30m.

alan_support: Granting now via ops UI. Command run: ```ops grant-credit --customer NIM-03 --invoice inv_2024_1108_0923 --amount 10000 --approver tom_sales --memo "Sales PO #98765 apply Q4 promo"```

alan_support: Done. Ledger adjustment id=ledger_adj_78890, tx_id=tx_78890, recorded by alan_support. Customer notified by support email.

mike_revops: I'll open a runbook item to backfill any other missed invoices in the same ingestion window. Query I'm going to run: `SELECT invoice_id FROM invoices WHERE customer='NIM-03' AND ingestion_time BETWEEN '2024-11-08T00:00:00Z' AND '2024-11-08T04:00:00Z' AND promo_expected=true AND credit_applied=false;`

jess_eng: PR ready to fix matcher logic: GH #2345 — changes: normalize whitespace, avoid matching when 'apply' directly precedes 'promo' without indicator words like 'manual' or 'hold'. I'll add unit tests for the PO note corpus from RevOps. Planning hotfix to staging now.

sara_cs: Thanks all. Customer has the ledger id and confirmation. They asked for a written note explaining root cause and the patch timeline. Can someone from Eng + RevOps draft a short blurb we can send?

jess_eng: I'll draft a short technical blurb + timeline and paste here in ~1 hr.

mike_revops: I'll run the backfill query and report any additional invoices by EOD. If there are >5 invoices we'll coordinate a batch credit and ops-runbook.

tom_sales: Appreciate fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

alan_support: Closing ticket TICKET-4593 after confirmation sent. Ledger id ledger_adj_78890 included in ticket notes.

sara_cs: Marking this thread resolved for CS. Follow-ups: jess_eng to post PR/patch link, mike_revops to post backfill results, tom_sales to confirm with Nimbus.

promo_bot: Auto-note: incident-type=manual-credit, severity=low, tags=[po-note, matcher-false-positive, enterprise].
